policies.test_derived: Seven files carry per-event or per-hit information about the test events: the test cache shape-form-martin/cache/pion_s1_test.pt, the earlier study's stored per-event test arrays shape-form-proton/results/particles/pion/test_v3_nll.npz, the test event order shape-form-martin/results/m0_parity/test_event_number.npy, and the four laptop test arrays shape-form-martin/results/m0_parity/{mlp,formula}_test_nll{,_ref1056}.npy. Rule (user decision P4, 25 Nov 2026): they are not copied with the rest of the package. They sit in their own lists (files_b_test_derived_inputs.txt to the same path, files_b_test_derived_records.txt into the quarantine root) and are copied to the H200 only after Gate 2c has passed. Until then `verify` FAILS if any of them exists on the H200 - at its live path, under the quarantine root, or under the same file name with the same size anywhere in the working tree, confirmed by SHA-256 (the test cache only by size and a byte hash) - and `verify --after-gate2c` requires all seven, verified by size and SHA-256. Reason: physical absence on the machine of record shows that nothing there read them before the final evaluation, without having to trust the test-access log (it has no host field, and load_sets writes its line before it opens the file, data.py:286-287) or a reading of the code. No moved step, import or campaign test reads the three test-derived inputs (static reading plus a run with them made invisible by an audit hook; see absence_before_gate2c). The raw Parquet table is deferred with them (same list files_b_test_derived_inputs.txt) but is not test-derived; see policies.raw_table.
policies.raw_table: The raw Parquet hit table shape-form-original/data/pion_standalone_N100000_M0_20GeV_reg_balanced_s1_v3.parquet is NOT test-derived - it is the source data, computed from no score and no split - but it CONTAINS the raw hits of all 99,689 events, the 14,956 test events included, because the train/val/test split is made only when the cache is built (sfm/data.py:150-160, seeded per momentum bin) and sfm.data.build_cache writes a test cache from it (data.py:227). The manifest therefore marks it contains_test_events = true and test_derived = false. User decision of 25 Nov 2026: it is deferred like the seven test-derived files - it travels in files_b_test_derived_inputs.txt and is copied to the H200 only after Gate 2c has passed - so that before Gate 2c no file holding test-event hits exists on the H200. Until then `verify` FAILS if it is at its live path (any content) or anywhere else in the working tree with the same name and size (confirmed by one SHA-256 of the 2.6 GB file); a Parquet file of another size (for example a train/val-only extract) is reported as information. `verify --after-gate2c` requires it present with its size and SHA-256 (and warns if its mtime differs from checksums.json). No moved step, import or campaign test reads it while the caches are copied.

policies.test_events_in_raw_parquet: State after the user decision of 25 Nov 2026: the Parquet raw table, which holds the hits of ALL 99,689 events including the 14,956 test events, is DEFERRED to after Gate 2c (list files_b_test_derived_inputs.txt; policies.raw_table).
